name: GFX_hof_ic_bukharin_economics_of_transition
title: 过渡时期的经济
concept: An ivory sculpted bridge linking a wheat field on the left to a compact factory on the right, unfinished final bridge segment being fitted, strong simple silhouettes. Transition and connection between agriculture and industry.

name: GFX_hof_ic_bukharin_nep_is_not_a_retreat
title: 新经济政策不是退却
concept: A bold ivory road arrow sweeping FORWARD and upward, flanked by a simple worker's hammer and a sheaf of wheat, unity moving forward, no soldiers or human figures.

name: GFX_hof_ic_bukharin_abolish_the_tribute
title: 取消「贡款」
concept: A large broken tax-collection seal beside a completely BLANK folded requisition paper, a snapped rope around a wheat sheaf in foreground. Controlled confrontational symbolism, no readable marks on seal/paper, no money.

name: GFX_hof_ic_bukharin_alliance_is_the_axis
title: 工农联盟是轴心
concept: A central solid mechanical axle and wheel hub joining an ivory worker's hammer on left and a sheaf of wheat on right, radiating sturdy spokes. Clear axis/union imagery, no handshake.

name: GFX_hof_ic_bukharin_enrich_yourselves
title: 发财吧
concept: An abundant ivory grain barn with open doors full of harvested wheat sheaves, one simple hand plough in foreground. Productive rural prosperity. Absolutely NO coins, money, currency, numbers or lettering.

name: GFX_hof_ic_bukharin_proportional_development
title: 按比例发展
concept: Two equal-sized ivory intermeshing industrial gears, one enclosing a small wheat relief and the other a factory relief, measured balanced growth, a drafting divider below them. Not a weighing scale.

name: GFX_hof_ic_bukharin_cooperatives_into_the_system
title: 合作社长入
concept: Three small ivory rural cooperative houses linked by broad converging channels to a larger three-column institutional bank building behind, integration into a shared system, readable bold architectural silhouettes. No currency or coins.

name: GFX_hof_ic_bukharin_left_communism
title: 左翼共产主义
concept: A DARKER gunmetal sword and agricultural plough facing in opposition across a sharp jagged divide; small single upward assault arrow behind. Ominous compressed shield-shaped deep burgundy backing, tarnished restrained bronze laurel, much darker than other icons, stern alternate path. No blood, people, text or real-world hate symbols.

name: GFX_hof_ic_bukharin_socialism_in_one_country
title: 一国建成社会主义
concept: A complete self-contained ivory sculpted industrial-agricultural state: broad factory and new buildings rising within a continuous enclosing boundary, wheat and compact turbine in foreground, cohesive completed construction. Most full and ceremonial composition in series, dense but legible, not a globe and not a turtle.
